name: so101_reach_mujoco_vectorized_wall_clock_v0
description: Wall-clock MuJoCo Menagerie RobotStudio SO-101 reach benchmark for the vectorized SAC seed.
notes: Use with seed_trainable_vectorized.py for fixed wall-clock SAC recipe research.
Reach success mirrors the SO101-Nexus ReachConfig default success_threshold=0.02 m, with targets sampled from a 0.15 m half-extent 3D workspace around the task center.
Episode horizon is 150 control steps so folded-start/camera-search policies have time to acquire and reach edge/corner fixed eval targets.
The environment and fixed eval case bank match the non-vectorized SO-101 reach benchmark.
